chunks: So believe in God, His Apostle and the Light We have sent down. God is well aware of what you do.
ai.seo_question: Who is the 'Light' mentioned in this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Light' (An-Nur) is frequently interpreted as the Prophet Muhammad and the Ahl al-Bayt, serving as the divine guide who illuminates the path to truth. This verse underscores the necessity of following this spiritual light alongside the Messenger, emphasizing that God is fully aware of how believers implement this guidance in their deeds.
